pairs.subject: production-trace-scoring
pairs.evidence: crates/engine/src/judge.rs:187 The engine's judge scores one (input, expected, output) case it is handed and has no trace identity, settle cutoff, sample gate or scored-queue; a search of crates/engine for sample_every, errors_always, settle_secs, unscored_for and coverage_receipt found nothing, because the live-traffic loop the subject governs lives in crates/runner/src/score_traces.rs, outside this context.

techniques.evidence: crates/engine/src/judge.rs:187 The engine is called with already-chosen text; deciding when a trace is finished happens in the runner's score_traces cycle, not here.
crates/engine/src/judge.rs:187 No trace id reaches the judge entry point, so it makes no sample-membership decision; the runner does that.
